name: pr-review-canvas
title_zh: 本地交互式 PR 走查图，点开就能逐文件看评审
tagline_zh: 代码评审别在网页里上下翻页了。生成一份本地 HTML 导览，按提交顺序逐块点亮改动，边看边批注，像逛展一样审 PR。
tagline_en: Stop scrolling the web diff. Generate a local HTML tour that walks each commit block-by-block, so you can review.
desc_en: Generate a local interactive HTML walkthrough of a GitHub PR or GitLab MR when a visual review is explicitly requested.
why_zh: 把 diff 按提交拆成可交互步骤，不是静态快照。改动脉络跟着 commit 走。
why_en: Turns a diff into an interactive step-by-step path tied to commits, so the review narrative follows logic, not file lists.
limit_zh: 只在用户明确要求可视化评审时触发；仅支持 GitHub PR 与 GitLab MR，且本机需能访问对应仓库。
limit_en: Only triggers on explicit visual-review request; supports GitHub PR & GitLab MR only, needs local repo access; output is a local HTML file—no.
title_en: Local interactive PR walkthrough map for visual review
